description: This Java interface defines a live command for modifying features in the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing access to the features to be modified and extending multiple command interfaces for thing identification and command behaviors.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command to modify features, providing access to the features to be modified and extending command and identification interfaces.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the new Features object to modify, referencing the Features to be processed by this command.
